name: Aldeanueva de Santa Cruz (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically red and yellow, charged at the centre with the white and black cross of the Order of Saint Dominic.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 8 April 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 77); the flag is described as square, parted at its centre, red at the hoist and yellow at the fly, with the white and black cross of the Order of Saint Dominic at the centre.

features.role: cross of the Order of Saint Dominic in white and black
